name: Kim's Deli
notes: 2 photos: a build-your-own-sandwich board (meat/bread/cheese/condiment choices and add-on prices, kept as one customizable item) and a printed specials board with named priced bowls; most dishes came from the specials board.

dishes.name: Craft Your Own Sandwich
dishes.description: choice of turkey, ham, roast beef, pastrami, corned beef, tuna salad, or egg salad on whole wheat, sourdough, rye, white, french roll, or ciabatta with American, cheddar, swiss, or provolone

dishes.name: Salmon Poke Bowl
dishes.description: Atlantic salmon (raw), seaweed salad, avocado, imitation crab, spicy mayo, cucumber, seaweed flakes, lemon on steamed rice

dishes.name: Grilled Salmon Bowl
dishes.description: grilled salmon, cucumber, avocado, carrot, imitation crab, lemon on steamed rice w/ housemade ponzu sauce

dishes.name: Spicy Tuna Bowl
dishes.description: spicy tuna (raw), avocado, cucumber, carrot on steamed rice w/ housemade ponzu sauce

dishes.name: Teriyaki Beef Sandwich
dishes.description: teriyaki beef, grilled onion, lettuce, tomato, cheese, mayo on french roll w/ salad & can soda

dishes.name: Bulgogi Bowl
dishes.description: Korean BBQ beef, glass noodle (jap-chae) on steamed rice & green salad w/ house dressing

dishes.name: Bibimbap
dishes.description: today's special; marinated beef, cucumber, pickled carrot, radish salad, shredded egg, seasoned bean sprout, mushroom, fried egg, steamed rice with red pepper paste & soybean sauce
